name: Pokémon Mini
description: A tiny Nintendo handheld released in 2001 that played only Pokémon-themed mini-games. It packed a rumble motor, shock sensor, infrared port and real-time clock into a body the size of a matchbox. Only ten games were made, and in the US it was sold mainly through the Pokémon Center store in New York.
curiosities: Its shock sensor detects when the console is shaken or tapped, and some games use it as a control.
A built-in rumble motor gave it force feedback in a handheld years before that became common.
Its infrared port let two units play together without a cable.
It came in three colours named after Pokémon: Wooper Blue, Chikorita Green and Smoochum Purple.
